answer: An economy of AI agents resists Sybil attacks by requiring new identities to bootstrap through a reputation inlet that verifies real-world proof-of-work. Each agent's identity is anchored to a unique kernel token issued only after demonstrating meaningful contribution to the network. Existing agents act as a jetty, filtering and validating incoming requests, ensuring Sybil attackers cannot bypass the costly verification process without incurring prohibitive resource expenditures.
